title: The Fool to the Hierophant: tarot card meanings
description: Tarot card meanings for The Fool, The Magician, The High Priestess, The Empress, The Emperor and The Hierophant, upright and reversed.

scenes.headline: The Fool to the Hierophant: tarot card meanings
scenes.caption: The first six major arcana cards, from The Fool to The Hierophant, with upright meanings and a short note on reversals.
scenes.vo: The first six major arcana cards, from The Fool to The Hierophant, with upright meanings and a short note on reversals.

scenes.headline: The Fool
scenes.caption: Keywords: new beginnings, trust, openness, risk. The Fool stands at the start, number zero, about to step forward.
scenes.vo: The Fool stands for new beginnings, trust, openness and risk.

scenes.headline: The Magician
scenes.caption: Keywords: skill, focus, resourcefulness, action. The Magician has what is needed on the table in front of them.
scenes.vo: The Magician stands for skill, focus, resourcefulness and action.

scenes.headline: The High Priestess
scenes.caption: Keywords: intuition, stillness, the unspoken, inner knowing. This card invites you to listen before acting and to notice what is not being said.
scenes.vo: The High Priestess stands for intuition, stillness, the unspoken and inner knowing.

scenes.headline: The Empress
scenes.caption: Keywords: nurture, abundance, creativity, comfort. The Empress is associated with growth, care and the senses. It often relates to creating conditions in which something can thrive.
scenes.vo: The Empress stands for nurture, abundance, creativity and comfort.
